outline:
—	To introduce the fundamental architectures, characteristics and applications of modern wireless radio frequency and microwave systems from a system approach point of view.
—	To introduce the analysis and design of critical components at the radio-frequency front-end stage of wireless system.
—	To introduce the analysis of mobile wideband wireless system performance based on system architecture, modulation techniques and radio propagation effect.
—	This course is particularly organized for a system engineer who needs the broad knowledge that may interweave with both communication and microwave engineerings
